brief: public MediaType detect(TikaInputStream tis, Metadata metadata, ParseContext context) throws IOException{}
method_comment: * Looks at the beginning of the document input stream to determine * whether the document is text or not. * * @param tis document input stream, or null * @param metadata ignored * @param context the parse context * @return "text/plain" if the input stream suggest a text document, * "application/octet-stream" otherwise
